$comment: The kit's notification card (nk::NotificationCard; #1156 step 3, point 5): one notification on its own glass, as the notification centre draws it today (toolkit/shell/src/nc_view.rs), which is the spec; final values require the owner's live review.
corner: the card's corner on the radius scale (the CC's 4×1, owner 2026-11-10); heroCorner: an open card's big picture. art: the app icon and the thumbnail beside the text.

text: the title and its weight, the age, a group's count and its weight, the body, an action's label and an error; lineHeight for all of them. lines: the body folded (and the room it keeps however short) and open, and an error.
glyph: the close and show-more glyphs. hero: a picture spans an open card when its source is at least source px wide; its height follows the picture between min and max.
Default applies to every dark/reduceTransparency variant; exported once as notification in each components.json variant.
